ORIGIN.quote: Activity also runs around the clock (revisions in all 24 UTC hours, peaking 18:00–21:00 UTC), and no label references any other vendor ("OpenAI", "GPT", "Gemini" etc. do not appear).
ORIGIN.reason: A reader learns that 564 of 3,103 usernames contain "Anthropic", that "Claude" appears, and that no rival vendor name appears — but every one of these facts is deployed only to argue the actors were AI agents rather than humans, and the report's account of origin stops at "a network-restricted, time-pressured, stateless-agent evaluation was run at scale" with the operator left unnamed throughout the analysis and confidence summary. It sits just above the 0.2 anchor because the "no other vendor" remark implicitly treats Anthropic/Claude as vendor identifiers and notes their exclusivity, but it falls well short of 0.4/0.6 because Anthropic is never raised — even to be dismissed — as a candidate source of the swarm.
